corrections.sheet: Tipo 2 - Registro De Socios O Partícipes
corrections.reason: The 2013 orden prints '104-500 BLANCOS', leaving 102-103 described by no field: the record runs 97-101 PORCENTAJE DE PARTICIPACION (subdivided 97-99 ENTERO, 100-101 DECIMAL) and then jumps to 104. Both later editions of the SAME orden print '102-500 BLANCOS', and the three editions are otherwise identical across the surrounding rows (95-96 DIA, 97-101, 97-99, 100-101, 108-120 NUMERO IDENTIFICATIVO). No edition describes a field at 102-103, so the span is filler in every reading and only the original mis-declares where filler begins.
